productArea.name: Record lists and views
productArea.scope: Browse, search, filter, sort, select, and group People, Companies, Opportunities, and Tasks records in table, Kanban, and calendar views, and manage saved views. Opening a record checks list navigation only; record detail pages, field editing, and notes or tasks content are outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Companies in the sidebar to search, filter, sort, and select records and manage views.
Choose People in the sidebar to use search, advanced filters, and sorting.
Choose Opportunities and switch to its Kanban view to change grouping and move cards.
Choose Tasks to use its board and calendar views.
